mapper.select: select cot.id, cot.clinic_id as orgId, botbotc.oralTariffCategoryId, botbotc.oralTariffCategoryName, botbotc.oralTariffCategoryNumber, botbotc.oralTariffId, botbotc.`name`, botbotc.englishName, botbotc.`number`, botbotc.unit, cot.price, cot.inservice from clinic_oral_tariff cot left join ( select bot.id as oralTariffId, botc.id as oralTariffCategoryId, botc.`name` as oralTariffCategoryName, botc.number as oralTariffCategoryNumber, bot.item_number as number, bot.`name`, bot.english_name as englishName, bot.unit from base_oral_tariff bot left join base_oral_tariff_category botc on bot.oral_tariff_category_id = botc.id ) botbotc on cot.oral_tariff_id = botbotc.oralTariffId where id = #{clinicOralTariffId}
